description: This file defines the TokenProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides various static methods to create, chain, memoize, and cache token provider functions, as well as to load profiles and create SSO token providers. The class facilitates flexible handling of AWS authentication tokens.

classes.name: TokenProvider
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate, chain, cache, and manage AWS token provider functions with support for SSO and shared config profiles.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default token provider that checks for cached SSO tokens or shared config.

methods.name: fromToken
methods.description: Creates a provider from a static token instance.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates an aggregate provider invoking multiple providers until one succeeds.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache its result and refresh if expired.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Caches tokens in a CacheInterface implementation.

methods.name: loadDefaultProfiles
methods.description: Loads AWS profiles from the ~/.aws/config file.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Returns a rejected promise with a TokenException.

methods.name: sso
methods.description: Creates an SSO token provider based on a profile and config.
